workflow (#1015). Reads and advances a durable per-(gaggle,workflow)

churn-digest to GOOBERS_INPUT_resultFile when declared, else stdout.

Exit codes: 0 = OK (including a clean no-work result), 1 = business error,
2 = usage/IO error.
